# Test fixtures

Every fixture is synthetic: written by hand for these tests, with made-up places, times and measurements. None comes from a real activity or device. Never add real activity files: they contain locations, times and health data.

| File | Covers |
|---|---|
| `activity.tcx` | One running activity with two laps, Activity Extension v2 (`TPX`, `LX`), an unknown extension namespace, an out-of-range heart rate, `Training`, a `Device_t` creator, an `Application_t` author and `xsi:schemaLocation`. |
